user.title: Meal Solver 3000
user.description: Enable Meal Solver 3000 to manage the week's dinners.

data_description.max_rules: How many times a tag may appear per week. Format: tag:count — e.g. 'beef:2, fish:1' means max 2 beef dishes and 1 fish dish per week. Leave empty for no upper limit.
data_description.min_rules: How many times a tag must appear per week. Format: tag:count — e.g. 'vegetarian:1' requires at least one vegetarian dish. Leave empty for no requirement.
data_description.no_consecutive: Tags naming interchangeable side dishes. Format: comma-separated list — e.g. 'potatis, ris, pasta'. Two dishes clash only if each offers exactly one of these and it is the same one: a dish tagged both 'pasta' and 'potatis' can be cooked either way and so never forces a repeat. Leave empty to allow anything.
data_description.repeat_interval: Days a dish must rest before it can be randomized again. E.g. 14 means the same dish won't appear for at least 2 weeks. Set to 0 to disable.
data_description.language: Language used in the Lovelace card. sv = Svenska, en = English.
data_description.auto_shuffle: When enabled, Meal Solver automatically generates a new week plan on the configured day and time. Disable if you prefer to shuffle manually only.
data_description.shuffle_weekday: Day of the week when the automatic shuffle runs.
data_description.shuffle_time: Time of day for the automatic shuffle in HH:MM format (e.g. 17:00).
